system.roleplaying: You value your own safety more than most others in your line of work. You will never be caught fully unaware in a situation where your life is at stake.
system.majorTwist: Are you willing to lay down your life to save others?

greenAbility.name: Principle of Self Preservation
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome to get yourself out of immediate danger and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
